svg.title: The landing zone abstraction iceberg
svg.desc: An abstraction iceberg with 3 layers below the waterline and 69 managed resources in total. Depth 1: app-infra (16), atlas_project · atlas_cluster · atlas_aws (3). Depth 2: http_edge · vpc (7), backup_export · backup_schedule · cloud_provider_access · encryption · encryption_private_endpoint · log_integration · privatelink (31). Depth 3: vpc (6).
svg.text: no default, so the caller must set them

Above the waterline: what you write

hybrid-search-ui lz example · us-east-1 · what the config declares, and what the modules declare for you
5 module calls → 69 managed resources · 29 declared by app-infra, 34 by the Atlas modules

Counts are managed resource instances in the lz stack's terraform.tfstate, grouped by the module that declares them. Required inputs are variables with no default. Depth 3 is the upstream terraform-aws-modules/vpc/aws module, vendored inside app-infra. Root resources are shown above the waterline and are not counted in any layer.
